keyQuestions.text: KQ1: What are the before numbers at HEAD after phases 014 and 015, using the committed capture in `--real-embedding` mode against a scratch copy of the database: plain tune recall, false offers of 35, the holdout count, and the three doctor-family floor rows at 0.82?

KQ2: When the six no-recommendation commands get richer intent signals in scratch copies of their owning metadata and their command vectors are re-embedded with the live embedder, what changes in the same capture: tune recall, false offers of 35, holdout count, and the three doctor-family floor rows?
KQ3: Does the measured gain justify a build, with the exact files and the measured gain, or a decline, with the number; and which of the six cannot benefit until it has a scorer row?

keyFindings.text: `/create:skill-parent` has no TypeScript bridge: it is in the capture's `unreachable` list, its typed row tops `sk-doc`, and its plain row carries no command. No command-vector change can reach it until a scorer row exists. [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/009-ux-performance-cross-cli-research/research/lineages/embed-text-4/scratch/before-capture.json] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/scripts/command-bridges/command-bridges.generated.json]

At HEAD `087888ec4a` the real-embedding capture reads typed recall 24 of 44, plain tune top-1 13 of 45, plain tune combined reach 28 of 45 (13 own plus 15 attached), plain holdout top-1 3 of 44, false offers 0 of 35 and `needs_mode_floor` 1 of 35. [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/009-ux-performance-cross-cli-research/research/lineages/embed-text-4/scratch/before-capture.json] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/scripts/routing-accuracy/capture-command-routing-baseline.mjs:618-658]

Each of the five scored no-recommendation commands has exactly one tune row and one holdout row, and every one is 0 at top-1 and 0 at top-3: `/doctor:install`, `/doctor:setup`, `/doctor:speckit`, `/doctor:update` and `/speckit:search`. [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/009-ux-performance-cross-cli-research/research/lineages/embed-text-4/scratch/before-capture.json] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/scripts/routing-accuracy/command-prompts.jsonl]

The scratch-database lane is faithful and repeatable: the capture exits 0, the database snapshot holds the same 46 command vectors and the same active embedder as the live file, and its numbers equal the segment-three real capture (13 of 45 tune, 3 of 44 holdout, 0 of 35 false offers). [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/009-ux-performance-cross-cli-research/research/lineages/embed-text-4/scratch/before-capture.json] [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/009-ux-performance-cross-cli-research/research/research-segment-3.md:39]

The three doctor-family floor rows at 0.82 offer no command: `mns-chat-03`, `nm-system-skilled-doctor-01` and `sv-03` all top `system-skilled-doctor` with `offered: false`, `top1: false` and `top3: false`. [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/009-ux-performance-cross-cli-research/research/lineages/embed-text-4/scratch/before-capture.json]

`/create:skill-parent` cannot move from this change: it has no TypeScript bridge, no stored command vector and no row for the capture to score, so its plain row stays empty even though its scratch text grew from 187 to 369 characters. It needs a scorer row, not more embedding text. [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/009-ux-performance-cross-cli-research/research/lineages/embed-text-4/scratch/metadata/enriched-embedding-text.json] [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/009-ux-performance-cross-cli-research/research/lineages/embed-text-4/scratch/after-capture.json]

The five tune rows that moved are exactly the five scored commands, and each moved from no command to its own command at top-1: `cmd-doctor-install-plain-tune-01`, `cmd-doctor-setup-plain-tune-01`, `cmd-doctor-speckit-plain-tune-01`, `cmd-doctor-update-plain-tune-01` and `cmd-speckit-search-plain-tune-01`. No other published tune row changed. [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/009-ux-performance-cross-cli-research/research/lineages/embed-text-4/scratch/after-capture.json] [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/009-ux-performance-cross-cli-research/research/lineages/embed-text-4/scratch/before-capture.json]

The holdout gain is two rows and is not tune-only: per-command holdout counts moved from 0 of 1 to 1 of 1 for `/doctor:install` and `/doctor:speckit`; `/doctor:setup`, `/doctor:update` and `/speckit:search` stayed at 0 of 1. Only counts were read; no holdout prompt text was printed. [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/009-ux-performance-cross-cli-research/research/lineages/embed-text-4/scratch/after-capture.json]

The measured gain is the vector half only: the capture still reads the tracked bridge projection for lexical evidence, so the build's other half (the same phrases in `ownedSignals` or `trigger_phrases`, which the deriver also copies into the TypeScript scorer) is not in these numbers. Adding 4 to 5 phrases grew each text by 165 to 233 characters, and the whole scratch re-embed of five command vectors plus two parity calls took 0.15 s wall with the model warm. [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/runtime/scripts/routing-accuracy/capture-command-routing-baseline.mjs:434] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/scripts/command-bridges/derive-command-bridges.cjs:660-680]

The re-embed path is faithful and the comparison is isolated: the unchanged text reproduces its stored vector at cosine 1.000000, each updated row is 3,072 bytes with model `nomic-embed-text-v1.5` and a matching content hash, every skill vector is byte-identical, and exactly the five scored command vectors changed. [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/009-ux-performance-cross-cli-research/research/lineages/embed-text-4/scratch/metadata/reembed-report.json] [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/009-ux-performance-cross-cli-research/research/lineages/embed-text-4/scratch/enrich-and-embed.mjs]

The three doctor-family floor rows that pass the gate at 0.82 still pass and still offer nothing: `mns-chat-03`, `nm-system-skilled-doctor-01` and `sv-03` all keep `system-skilled-doctor` as the top, read `offered: false`, `top1: false`, and sit inside the unchanged false-offer total of 0 of 35. [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/009-ux-performance-cross-cli-research/research/lineages/embed-text-4/scratch/after-capture.json]

With the enriched vectors the committed capture reads plain tune top-1 18 of 45 (was 13), plain tune combined reach 33 of 45 (was 28), plain holdout top-1 5 of 44 (was 3), false offers 0 of 35 (unchanged), typed recall 24 of 44 (unchanged) and `needs_mode_floor` 1 of 35 (unchanged). [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/009-ux-performance-cross-cli-research/research/lineages/embed-text-4/scratch/after-capture.json] [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/009-ux-performance-cross-cli-research/research/lineages/embed-text-4/scratch/before-capture.json]

**Answer: build the five scored commands.** The measured vector-only gain is plain tune top-1 13 to 18 of 45 (+5), combined tune reach 28 to 33 of 45 (+5), holdout top-1 3 to 5 of 44 (+2), false offers 0 of 35 unchanged, typed recall 24 of 44 unchanged. That changes segment three rank 10's disposition from "measure first" to "build", and it is the first measurement in this segment that moves holdout rows without touching a floor. [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/009-ux-performance-cross-cli-research/research/lineages/embed-text-4/scratch/after-capture.json] [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/009-ux-performance-cross-cli-research/research/research-segment-3.md:75]

`/create:skill-parent` needs a scorer row before its text can matter: add its four signals to `.skilled/skills/sk-doc/command-metadata.json` (entry at line 48), add a TypeScript activation entry in `.skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/scripts/command-bridges/scoring-compatibility.json`, flip its generated `scorerRow` at `.skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/command-attach.ts:135` by rerunning `derive-command-bridges.cjs`, then re-embed. Its measured gain is 0 today, so it is a prerequisite, not part of this lane's +5/+2. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/sk-doc/command-metadata.json:48] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/command-attach.ts:135] [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/009-ux-performance-cross-cli-research/research/lineages/embed-text-4/scratch/metadata/enriched-embedding-text.json]

The build must recapture two baselines, not just the real capture. The fixture capture's hits depend on bridge metadata, so a metadata edit changes the committed ratchet and `capture-command-routing-baseline.mjs --write` must be rerun under the fixture regime. The real capture then proves the live numbers: tune 18 of 45 or better, holdout 5 of 44 or better, false offers 0 of 35, typed 24 of 44. The doctor route validators (`route-validate.sh`, `doctor-phrase-reach.cjs`) also run because the phrases land in `_routes.yaml`. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/scripts/routing-accuracy/capture-command-routing-baseline.mjs:676-694]

The exact build edits are three metadata files: add five phrases to `/doctor:install`, five to `/doctor:setup`, five to `/doctor:speckit` and four to `/doctor:update` in `.skilled/commands/doctor/_routes.yaml` (routes at lines 626, 376, 65 and 758), and add four phrases to `/speckit:search` `userIntent.ownedSignals` in `.skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/command-metadata.json` (entry at line 215). The deriver copies these into the command bridge's embedding text and the TypeScript scorer. [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/_routes.yaml:65,376,626,758] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/command-metadata.json:215] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/scripts/command-bridges/derive-command-bridges.cjs:660-700]

The lane made no tracked change: every write is inside the lineage folder, and the target metadata files, the database and the generated bridge projection are clean in `git status`. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/database/skill-graph.sqlite] [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/_routes.yaml]

The measured gain is a lower bound because it is the vector half only. The build also adds lexical evidence: the same phrases live in `trigger_phrases` or `ownedSignals`, which the deriver copies into the TypeScript scorer. That half is unmeasured and is the build's real risk: a broad phrase such as "list every check this project has" could lift a near-miss or must-not-start row. The 0 of 35 false-offer gate is the control; if it moves, narrow the phrase before landing. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/scripts/command-bridges/derive-command-bridges.cjs:40-60,660-700] [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/009-ux-performance-cross-cli-research/research/lineages/embed-text-4/scratch/after-capture.json]

The re-embed step already exists: rerun `node .skilled/bin/skill-advisor.cjs skill_graph_scan --trusted --format json`, whose handler calls `indexSkillMetadata` and then `refreshSkillEmbeddings` (`scan.ts:53-54`), so the changed bridge projection refreshes the command vectors. The scratch run proved the text-to-vector path is faithful at cosine 1.000000 and costs 0.15 s warm for five vectors plus two parity calls. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/handlers/skill-graph/scan.ts:49-62] [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/routing-and-scoring/008-command-surfacing-build/009-ux-performance-cross-cli-research/research/lineages/embed-text-4/scratch/metadata/reembed-report.json]

ruledOutDirections.text: A plain file copy of the WAL-mode database: the `-wal` file may hold committed rows, so `.backup` was used for a consistent snapshot.
None yet. The lane has a working baseline and a scratch copy that the enrichment run can reuse.
Running the capture against the live database in place: it would measure whatever the daemon wrote and would leave no before snapshot for the after run.
Command vector enrichment alone cannot make `/create:skill-parent` reachable. This is a definitive dead end for that command until a bridge row exists.
Copying the enriched bridge projection over the tracked file so the capture's lexical lane sees it: that would modify a tracked file and break the isolation the measurement needs.
Re-embedding `/create:skill-parent`: there is no `vec_cmd_768` row and no TypeScript id, so the update would write a vector nothing reads.
Claiming the lexical half as measured: the scratch capture read the tracked bridge projection, so the lexical addition is a build-time risk, not a measured gain.
Declining the build: the measured cost of declining is 5 tune rows and 2 holdout rows left without a command, with no floor movement to justify the loss.
Enriching only the skill descriptions instead of command metadata: segment three rank 16 already declined it and measured 0 holdout gain; this lane's +2 comes from command vectors, not skill text.
Reusing the doctor route `lead_phrases` mechanism: it is for leading a passing skill, not for adding volume to the embedding text, and it carries its own state-word constraint.
Treating `/create:skill-parent` as part of the same gain: its measured gain is 0 until a scorer row exists, so folding it into the +5/+2 would overclaim.
